answer: Prism-linked dawn attestations: each agent action must carry a proof that its signing key was derived at a fresh epoch boundary from a unique onyx seed the network issues only after observing sustained non-clone behavior. New keys start quarantined: low rate limits, no revenue share until the seed matures. Cloning a seed forces re-quarantine across all derived keys, forfeiting accrued epoch credits and rate capacity; cloning without a seed yields unusable unendorsed keys. Marginal clone EV is negative because replacement cost (lost credits plus quarantine delay) exceeds any first-epoch yield.
